notes.title: 《Whisper of the shade: Gray》 is ready on Steam!
notes.content:
《Whisper of the shade: Gray》is ready on Steam!

Push open the wooden door, 
and a familiar aroma of coffee mingles perfectly with the gentle sweetness of pastries.

Take a seat by the window, 
bathed in the soft afternoon sunlight,as the greetings from the staff feel like a warm ray of sunshine.

The exclusive coffee shop, Grey Hawk, is now live on Steam.
We warmly welcome all our store managers to visit!
